title: Pixel-World Portfolio
shortDescription: A recruiter-friendly portfolio with an optional explorable pixel world.
longDescription: This site combines direct portfolio navigation with a compact interactive world. The implementation emphasizes JSON-driven content, simple collision rectangles, and placeholder-first visual development so final art can be swapped in later.
whyItMatters: It demonstrates product thinking, frontend architecture, accessibility, and creative interaction design without blocking recruiters from the core content.

title: Operations Dashboard
shortDescription: A placeholder SaaS dashboard focused on scanning, filtering, and action workflows.
longDescription: A structured dashboard concept for tracking operational metrics, reviewing records, and moving from summary views to detail actions quickly.
whyItMatters: It shows how dense information can stay readable when the layout, hierarchy, and interaction patterns are carefully designed.

title: Study Planner
shortDescription: A planning tool concept for deadlines, priorities, and weekly focus.
longDescription: A student-oriented productivity app concept that organizes upcoming work into a practical weekly plan with emphasis on clarity and low-friction editing.
whyItMatters: It highlights pragmatic product design: small workflows, clear states, and data structures that are easy to extend.
